local_findings.problem: SQL runtime hold accepted a different same-workspace owner; a later malformed start row could satisfy an incomplete owner guard
local_findings.fix: Additive 0032 SQL owner trigger and runtime activity select the immutable sequence-1 start subject. Existing valid ownership survives revocation; inconsistent history stops upgrade without rewriting rows. Populated downgrade refuses weaker protection.

local_findings.reviewer: root local inspection of unpublished migration candidate; not independent
local_findings.problem: A concurrent wrong-owner hold could commit between preflight and trigger installation in the new candidate migration
local_findings.fix: Hold SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE table lock across preflight and DDL in both directions, with a three-second lock timeout. A real blocked-writer/commit regression proves the upgraded guard sees the committed row and stops without changing history.
